name: browser-verify
description: Verify local browser workflows with reproducible evidence and bounded adaptive decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Check local app changes with browser evidence.
interface.longDescription: Inspect controls, execute scoped workflows, verify persisted state, and return evidence to the coding agent. Deterministic by default, with optional budgeted Jev routing.
defaultPrompt: Verify the local app changes and fix any reproduced failures.
